name: Sportarr
description: Sportarr is an event manager for sports fans. It monitors leagues and events, grabs broadcasts via Usenet and BitTorrent, then sorts and renames them into a season/episode layout media servers like Plex, Emby and Jellyfin understand. Quality profiles, calendar, DVR-style IPTV recording and automatic upgrades included.
short_desc: Sports event manager for Usenet and BitTorrent
author: Sportarr
